title: Agenda
caption: Three hours, times from the start: two and a half hours of content, then the handover to CyberLab and the debrief.

first.title: Treat AI like a brilliant freelancer with amnesia

second.title: Why AI has a weird attention span you must learn to manage

third.title: Will AI reduce your work? It adds work: managing it.

talking-points.description: 30 minutes of welcome, five of them for late arrivals, then Episode 1 (20), the “Grill me” demo (20) and a 10-minute break. Episode 2 (30), Episode 3 (10), hands-on time (20) and the master class tracks (10) close the content at 2:30. The handover to CyberLab (15) and questions, debrief and feedback (15) fill the last half hour; there is no other buffer. Each check-in belongs to its Episode’s time.
